Free audio plugins

alltheplugins.com is an open-source collection of high-quality audio plugins that anybody can use to express their musical creativity.

I’m a software developer and musician. This is a personal, noncommercial project and a gift from me to the world. I simply want to share.

Choose the download for your operating system and plugin format on each plugin’s page.

Getting started

  1. Browse the downloads below. Search by name or inspiration, or filter by type.
  2. Open a plugin’s page for its download, requirements, controls, installation instructions, and license.
  3. Install it in your audio host and make music.

About the project

Made for music.
Shared freely.

Independent audio plugins, built by a musician and shared with anyone who wants to create.

I simply want to share.

I’m a software developer and musician, building an open-source collection of high-quality audio plugins that anybody can use to express their musical creativity.

This is a personal project, not a company. There’s no commercial or capitalist motive behind it. These plugins are a gift from me to the world.

Free to use.

Your creativity should not be locked behind a paywall. I want to put creative tools in your hands so you can make music, express yourself, and create human art without the cost of entry.

Make it yours.

My MIT-licensed plugin binaries come with broad permissions to use, modify, and share. Each plugin page includes its full license and required notices.

Pass it on.

Modify a plugin to match your workflow, or mix and match to spark new ideas. Share what you make and contribute through the project repository.

A few practical details

Getting started

Each plugin page lists its downloads, specific requirements, controls, and installation instructions. Choose the download for your operating system and plugin format.

About the inspirations

My plugins are inspired by sounds and workflows I’ve encountered in my 20+ years as a music producer and mix engineer. All my plugins are original software, inspired by familiar sounds to enable your creativity. I have no affiliation with the vendors of products that inspire them.

Source code

To keep things tidy, this site and the public repository currently contain plugin downloads, but no source code. The source code for all my plugins will be posted in the coming days. I’m getting it ready and want to present it in a clean, accessible way.

A personal project, freely shared.
